qrScanner.description: Scan QR codes using your camera or image files.
qrScanner.dragDrop: Drag or click to upload an image

howTo.title: How to Use
items: In the Camera tab, point the QR code at your camera for auto-detection
In the Image tab, upload an image containing a QR code
Detected content is automatically displayed and can be copied

tips.title: Scanning Tips
items: The QR code should be clear and large enough
Damaged or partially covered QR codes may be difficult to detect

whatIs.title: What is the QR Code Scanner?
whatIs.description: A browser-based tool that reads QR codes and barcodes using your device's camera or an uploaded image file, instantly displaying the encoded information (URL, text, contact info, etc.). No app installation required — works directly in your web browser.

items.a: Camera permission is required for live scanning. Image file upload works without camera permission and supports screenshots, downloaded images, and gallery photos.

items.q: Can it scan QR codes in screenshots?
items.a: Yes. Use the image upload feature to scan QR codes from screenshots, downloaded images, or photos in your gallery. The image must be clear and the QR code must be fully visible.

items.q: Does it scan regular barcodes too?
items.a: Yes, common 1D barcode formats including Code128, EAN-13, UPC-A, and ITF are supported. Note that barcode scanning is more sensitive to angle and lighting than QR code scanning.

batch.nativeUnavailable: This browser cannot use its native QR feature for the camera or single-image reader. Multiple images can use an alternative decoder on your device.
batch.title: Read QR codes from multiple images
batch.description: Select images and start reading to process one file at a time. Each file shows the first QR code successfully read.
batch.limits: Up to 10 PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF files · 8 MiB per file · 40 MiB total · 16,777,216 source pixels. Only one animation frame is read; the full animation is not inspected.
batch.processingHint: Images are reduced to a longest edge of 2,048px, so small QR codes may be missed. Each file has a 20-second limit. If an image contains several QR codes, crop the desired area and select it again.
batch.scaled: This image was reduced for processing. If a small QR code was missed, crop its area and select it again.
batch.multiple: Several QR codes were detected. Only the first successfully read result is shown.
batch.emptyText: The QR code was read, but its text content is empty.
batch.privacy: Selected images and results stay in this screen's memory. They are not uploaded or automatically saved to recent history or the URL. TXT includes only checked successful results.
batch.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the original text below to copy it manually, or try again.

errors.fileSize: The file must contain at least 1 byte and be no larger than 8 MiB.
errors.format: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
errors.dimensions: The source exceeds 16,777,216 pixels or has invalid dimensions.
errors.read: The image is damaged or cannot be read by this browser.
errors.worker: The alternative QR decoder could not run. Try reading again.
errors.timeout: Processing took too long. Crop the QR area and select it again, or retry.

notices.count: Choose 1–10 images at once. The previous list was kept.
notices.total: The selected files exceed 40 MiB in total. The previous list was kept.
notices.downloaded: The selected results' TXT download was requested.
notices.downloadFailed: The TXT download could not be requested. Your selection was kept; try again.

historyErrors.corrupt: Saved recent history has an unreadable format and was left unchanged. You can keep reading QR codes.
historyErrors.unavailable: Recent-history storage could not be accessed. The current QR result remains available on screen.
historyErrors.conflict: Recent history changed in another screen. Reload it before trying again.
historyErrors.quota: There is not enough space to save recent history. Copy the current result to keep it.
historyErrors.unverified: The storage state could not be verified after writing. Reload recent history to check what was saved.
